canonical.note: Current Status-A retains Full Richards as admitted reference production path and does not canonically admit a production ROM.

rom_purpose.current_question: purpose-specific state-count sufficiency and closure attribution
rom_purpose.reason: The live P3 contract and its new same-partition Richards materializer concern SURF_P and GW_LB representation/closure attribution. They do not define root-uptake or drought-stress structural-error tolerances, temporal acceptance semantics, or an operational root-feedback purpose envelope.

rationale: ROM-ROOT already established the exact forcing-portable information boundary: arbitrary demand-dependent Feddes feedback requires threshold-queryable root-weighted within-layer pressure-head distribution information or an equivalent object.
The only ROM-PURPOSE delta since the previous refresh is implementation support for a same-partition Richards P3 diagnostic under SURF_P/GW_LB.
Neither the live P3 preregistration nor status record creates a root-feedback application or structural-error tolerance.
ROM-ACCEPT is unchanged and supplies no matching quantitative root-feedback acceptance budget.
Therefore no scientific criterion exists for selecting a finite approximate root descriptor from observed ROM-ROOT errors.
reopen_conditions: An independent purpose owner freezes a root-feedback or root-stress structural-error budget with temporal, spatial and event semantics.
ROM-PURPOSE closes an explicit root-feedback purpose contract requiring an approximation frontier independent of application acceptance.
A separately scoped approximation-theory study is explicitly authorized with no sufficiency or application-admission claim.
